geometry: Central golden phoenix emblem within a flaming solar ring; horizontal format with upper and lower Celtic knot borders
color_palette: Dominant amber, gold, and burnt orange hues; dark metallic grey for the intricate knotwork borders
symbolism: The phoenix represents rebirth, eternal fire, and transcendence; the Celtic knots suggest cycles and interconnectedness
cultural_hints: A society focused on spiritual renewal, cycles of life, and ancestral traditions with a high regard for fire
distinctive_traits: The background features a dynamic, painterly swirling smoke effect that draws the eye toward the central radiating emblem
